criteria.label: Instruction following
criteria.description: Meets every constraint: length, count, script, register, format.

criteria.label: Accuracy and safety
criteria.description: No wrong facts, wrong arithmetic, changed meaning, invented details or unsafe advice.

criteria.label: Language quality
criteria.description: Correct grammar and gender agreement, natural wording, right script, no unnecessary English mixing.

criteria.label: Helpfulness
criteria.description: Gives the reader what they need, in a form they can use.

criteria.label: Tone and register
criteria.description: Respectful 'आप'/'આપ' forms where needed; polite, never rude or threatening.
